title: Improve code coverage: add tests for app.ts
body:
This PR improves the code coverage of the project by adding unit tests for the main application entry point, `src/app.ts`.

Key changes:
- Created `src/test/app.test.ts`.
- Implemented tests for the `main()` function in `app.ts` by using module re-evaluation (clearing `require.cache`) and mocking global/builtin objects.
- Verified that coverage for `app.ts` reached 100%.
- Ensured no production code was modified, respecting the task constraints.
